CR_0685_RG_NO_CETUX.justification: No structured medication evidence or note evidence was found for this patient confirming bevacizumab use, nor documenting absence or presence of concomitant cetuximab/panitumumab. Because negative exclusion criteria require chart documentation rather than chart silence, the criterion cannot be confirmed.

CR_0685_GUARD_NSCLC_NO_PEM_MAINT.justification: No structured medication records were found for bevacizumab or pemetrexed, and the chart notes only document NSCLC with plans for palliative chemotherapy/radiation and airway stenting. There is no chart evidence that bevacizumab is not being used as maintenance therapy with pemetrexed, nor any explicit exclusion/absence statement for that regimen.

The returned records did not provide status or dates, but the code presence itself supports the diagnosis requirement.
